desc:
Welcome to Cut Vines for Brainrots! 🌿

Get close to any door, cut through the vines, and get Brainrots! ⚔️
Bring Brainrots back to your base to generate money! 💵
Upgrade your machete, cutting power, and stats! 💪
Unlock new jungle zones and stronger vines! 🔓
Collect rare, Secret, and OG Brainrots! ✨

How far can you cut? 🕒

👍 Like the game for more updates!
